name: Bell Maiden's Bloom
source:
Within Alyssum, the land of the divine, two major religions guide the lives of the people. They are the Bell Flower Faith of Kaffir, and the Dianthus Faith of the Labyrinth.

Tensions have always been high between these groups. And once their deities vanished from the realm, the fragile peace these faiths once held quickly dissolved.

As "Bell Maiden", you were born into the divine bloodline blessed by Amaranthus, the deity of your religion, and possess a unique gift. As a proxy to God, you have the power to cultivate Bell Flowers; magical blooms with miraculous healing capabilities of Amaranthus' creation.

You must uphold your duties to the church and to the citizens of Kaffir. In these troubling times, the people look to you for security as you keep the memento from Amaranthus, the Bell Flowers, from withering away.

But not all is what it seems in the Holy City...

A frightening darkness lies beneath the church, but it's up to you whether to uncover its mysteries, or stay loyal to your faith.

[From [url=https://healer-class.itch.io/bell-maidens-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
